reviewContext.issueReference: No GitHub issue. Inline workflowInput.requestedBehavior (ART hourly recovery 2026-11-11: Bug A manual-run overlap, Bug B terminal-step reserve); accepted at step5-impl-plan-review comm-000008 in opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-1.
reviewContext.userProblem: Bug A: a manual `riela instance run` (App route POST /api/v1/instances/{identity}/runs) session (hourly-refresh-session-249) was invisible to the cron overlapPolicy skip, so cron ticks launched sessions 250 and 252 concurrently on the same state and double-published; the run route also starts a second concurrent manual execution. Bug B: DeterministicWorkflowRunner.redirectForTerminalReservationIfNeeded redirects to the terminal corridor whenever remaining budget <= max(3, corridor size), so a 2-step acyclic workflow with maxLoopIterations 1 (budget 3) jumped straight to `remediate` without running `check` (output-monitor-session-251/255); long acyclic chains likewise skip steps.
requiredOutcomes: With a manual instance run in progress, a cron tick of the same instance with overlapPolicy skip is skipped with an overlap-skip receipt naming the manual session.
`riela instance run` while an execution is running returns a stable `instance_busy` error naming the running session; `--allow-overlap` bypasses it.
A 2-step acyclic workflow with maxLoopIterations 1 executes both steps; no terminal-step-reserve redirect occurs.
A 15-step linear workflow with maxLoopIterations 1 executes every step.
Existing loop-guard tests for cyclic workflows still pass unchanged.
swift build and focused swift test filters pass; lint clean on changed files; docs/app-instance-control.md and README updated.
nonGoals: No change to cron-vs-cron overlap behavior, reason formats, receipt shapes, routine gate or admission-gate semantics.
No cancellation of sessions owned by another process (cancelRunning with only external blockers skips).
No change to reserve window arithmetic, marker shape, payload carry-over, maxStepsExceeded, LoopTerminalCorridorSelector.select, corridor construction or authored loop policy.
No leases, timers or persistence beyond the design; no change to reload/executions response shapes (only added fields/error codes).
No user-doc entry for the terminal-reserve bug fix.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Shared public RielaCLI contract LiveRootSession / LiveRootSessionProbe.liveRootSessions(workflowId:sessionStoreRoot:) (mrot-02): read-only SQLite overview of created/running root sessions plus non-creating O_RDONLY flock probe of execution-locks/<sessionId>.lock; isManual = named kind or ephemeral with non-default base identity.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: App (manual) and events-serve (cron) processes share one per-profile store; flock OFD semantics report same-process holders as live; crashed/orphaned sessions never block (design §3.1).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: CronOverlapDispatcher consults external manual blockers only when the binding scope is idle (no in-process run/queue/pending); skip and cancelRunning both skip naming the manual session; queue enters a queued-idle state advanced FIFO by advanceExternallyBlocked with no await between probe and start; concurrent counts external runs toward the cap; probe errors fail open with telemetry.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps cron-vs-cron unchanged, never cancels foreign sessions, and closes the DR-001 FIFO interleaving race (design §3.2).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: App configured-run route refuses with HTTP 409 {error:{code:instance_busy,runningSessionId}} unless body allowOverlap:true; check runs synchronously inside launchConfiguredWorkflow before run_limit and before launch registration; CLI adds --allow-overlap (sent only when set) and maps 409 to stdout {error,sessionId,exitCode} exit 1.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Atomic check-and-claim inside the serialized App route; older Apps keep exact key set (design §3.3, §3.4).

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Terminal reserve precondition: skip redirect when LoopTerminalCorridorSelector.acyclicRemainingStepBound(origin) is non-nil and <= remainingSteps; any reachable cycle returns nil and keeps today's behavior.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Reserve exists only to stop undeclared loops; acyclic paths that fit the budget must run every step; explicit small maxSteps still redirects (design §4).

intentionalTradeoffs: Cross-process sub-second race window before session allocation is accepted (design §3.5).
Instances sharing a workflow id in one profile share the busy/overlap check.
External probe failures fail open (fire starts) with telemetry rather than blocking cron.
Store probe in App route counts all live root sessions (cron and manual) as busy.
supportedEdgeCases: Manual session live while cron scope idle under skip/cancelRunning/queue/concurrent policies.
Queue head deferred by an external blocker then FIFO-advanced on next submit or serve-loop/drain tick; routine-deactivated head skipped with gate reason.
In-process cron run plus manual run under skip names the in-process session.
Orphaned lock (released/missing) does not block; child sessions and other workflow ids ignored.
409 instance_busy without runningSessionId keeps generic CLI failure output; --allow-overlap rejected for non-run actions.
Diamond/labelled-edge acyclic graphs, self-loops and downstream 2-cycles in acyclicRemainingStepBound; maxSteps smaller than longest path still redirects.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Cancelling or coordinating sessions owned by another process.
Leases/persistence to close the pre-allocation race window.
Per-instance (rather than per-workflow-id) discrimination within a profile.
residualRisks: DR-001 correctness depends on the no-await discipline in advanceExternallyBlocked and the finish/advanceDeferred probe guard; the mrot-04 FIFO interleaving test must run.
EventLiveServe default session-store root resolution must reuse the WorkflowRunCommand resolver; a wrong root makes the probe silently return []; App always passes --session-store.
Known flaky interleaved-submit test in the full suite; verification uses focused filters only.
Shared .build contention across parallel RielaCLI plans: log sibling breaks and re-run, never fix sibling files.

acceptanceCriteria: LoopTerminalCorridorSelector.acyclicRemainingStepBound(workflow:originStepId:) added (nil on reachable cycle or unknown origin, longest local path step count otherwise) and redirectForTerminalReservationIfNeeded returns nil when bound <= remainingSteps, checked after the window guard and before input resolution.
